reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is #8841.

The source is Tobias's post in that same channel yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on #8841 for support. Tobias has owned Marrow Fieldworks since January, so I suggested she check the latest status with him before the call.

I didn't find a separate ticket file for Marrow Fieldworks that she has access to. Other Marrow ticket numbers do turn up (MFW-218, #4409, #4412, PD-8841), but they're for different issues, like a Door 4/6 reassignment and a request for a high-contrast mode on the gate kiosk. I don't think any of them is this one.
